title: Verbal Prefixes 4: вы- (out, exhaust, complete)
titleRussian: Глагольные приставки 4: вы- (наружу, до конца, исчерпать)
description: The prefix вы- carries an 'outward' or 'completely done' shade: take out (вынести), drink up to the last drop (выпить), learn by heart (выучить), carry out a task (выполнить). The prefix usually steals stress in the past tense.
descriptionRussian: Приставка вы- даёт оттенок «наружу» или «полностью завершено»: вынести (взять и понести наружу), выпить (выпить до дна), выучить (выучить наизусть), выполнить (исполнить полностью). В прошедшем времени ударение обычно перетягивается на саму приставку.
intro: Three shades again: physically out of somewhere, using something up entirely, or carrying a task through to the end. There is also a recognition trick unique to this prefix. In many past forms it pulls the stress onto itself, which no other prefix does, so an unexpected stress at the front of a verb is usually this one.
rules: Shade 1 (out, spatial): вы- on physical-action verbs → 'out of a bounded space.' Вынести, выйти, выехать, выбросить, выпустить.
Shade 2 (exhaust, consume up): вы- on consumption verbs → 'drink / eat / use up completely.' Выпить, выкурить, вычистить, вылить. Often paired with весь / всё.
Shade 3 (complete a task): вы- on effort verbs → 'carry out fully to the end.' Выучить, выполнить, выгладить. Often against implied resistance or effort.
Stress shift: вы- pulls stress onto itself in many past forms (выпил, выучил, вышел). This is a recognition signal unique to this prefix.
Derived imperfectives: many вы- perfectives pair with -ивать / -ывать impf forms (выпить / выпивать, выучить / выучивать) that keep the prefix but follow normal stress.
examples: Антон вынес мусор перед уходом. (Anton took the rubbish out before leaving.) Shade 1: spatial out.
Я выпил весь чай за завтраком. (I (m) drank all the tea at breakfast.) Shade 2: consume up, with весь cue.
Игорь выучил все правила к экзамену. (Igor learned all the rules through to the exam.) Shade 3: complete the task; все cue.
Лена выполнила свою часть работы за вечер. (Lena carried out her part of the work in an evening.) Shade 3: complete to the end.
Дети вышли из класса на перемену. (The kids came out of the classroom for break.) Shade 1: spatial out, motion verb.
Вера вылила старую воду и налила свежую. (Vera poured out the old water and poured in fresh.) Shade 2: consume / empty container.

tables.title: Three shades of вы- with example verbs

rows.label: Out (spatial)
cells: из + gen source phrase; spatial out-of-a-container framing

rows.label: Exhaust / consume up
cells: весь / всё / все cue; empty container as result

rows.label: Complete a task
cells: all-the-X cue; task brought to full completion

tables.title: The вы- stress shift in the past tense

items.prompt: Учитель _____ класс на пять минут раньше.
items.promptEnglish: The teacher let the class out five minutes early.
items.hint: 'Let out' of the room. Shade 1: which prefix means 'out of a bounded space'?
items.explanation: Letting the class out of the room (from inside to outside) signals shade 1 of вы-: вы- + пустить → выпустил. Впустил means 'let in' (the opposite direction); пропустил means 'let through / missed'; пустил alone is 'let / allowed' without the 'out' framing.

items.prompt: Лена _____ мусор перед уходом на работу.
items.promptEnglish: Lena took the rubbish out before leaving for work.
items.hint: 'Out' of the apartment, before leaving. Shade 1: which prefix?
items.explanation: The spatial 'out' framing (rubbish moved from inside to outside) signals shade 1 of вы-: вы- + нести → вынести, past fem вынесла. Несла (impf) is the ongoing carrying; понесла is onset of motion (started carrying); принесла is 'brought here.'

items.promptEnglish: Anton drank all the tea at breakfast.
items.hint: 'Весь чай' = the whole pot, consumed up. Shade 2: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Весь' (all) plus the consume-up framing signals shade 2 of вы-: вы- + пить → выпил. The весь cue is the canonical signal for the вы- consume-completely shade. Note the stress shift onto вы-. Пил is the impf process; допил would fit if drinking was already in progress (also valid but with a different framing); перепил means 'drink too much / overdrink.'

items.promptEnglish: I (m) learned all the rules through to the exam.
items.hint: 'Все правила' + 'к экзамену' = mastered everything. Shade 3: which prefix?
items.explanation: 'Все правила' (all the rules) plus the к + dat deadline signals shade 3 of вы-: вы- + учить → выучил (learned through to mastery, all of them). Note the stress on вы-. Учил is impf process; доучил would be 'finished a learning in progress' (slightly different framing); переучил would mean 'relearn / retrain.'

items.promptEnglish: The kids came out of the classroom for the break.
items.hint: 'Из класса' + 'на перемену' = exited the room. Shade 1: which motion prefix?
items.explanation: 'Из + gen' (out of the classroom) plus the bounded source framing signals shade 1 of вы-: вы- + идти → выйти, past pl вышли. Шли is the ongoing walking; пошли is onset of motion; пришли is 'arrived (came here).' Only вышли captures the threshold-out reading.

items.prompt: Лена _____ свою часть работы за вечер.
items.promptEnglish: Lena carried out her part of the work in an evening.
items.hint: 'Carried out a task' in a bounded time. Shade 3: which вы- verb?
items.explanation: 'Carry out her part of the work' is shade 3 of вы-: выполнить (complete a task / fulfil a duty). Past fem of выполнить: выполнила. Делала (impf) is the ongoing process; сделала would frame the same task more neutrally; переделала means 'redo from scratch.'

items.prompt: Лена _____ весь чай и попросила ещё.
items.promptEnglish: Lena drank up all the tea and asked for more.
items.explanation: The consume-up shade is вы-: выпила весь чай. Попила means 'had some'; допила 'finished off the remainder'; запила 'washed something down'.

items.promptEnglish: Lena learned all the words (to mastery) for the exam.
items.hint: Task-complete mastery of the whole set.
items.explanation: The mastered-in-full shade is вы-: выучила все слова. Учила is the open-ended studying; доучила the last portion; заучила rote-crammed.

items.promptEnglish: Masha came out of the classroom for the break.
items.explanation: Spatial exit takes вы-: вышла из класса. Ушла would mean gone for the day; пошла marks setting off; зашла dropping in.

items.prompt: Игорь _____ свою часть работы до конца.
items.promptEnglish: Igor carried out his part of the work to the end.
items.hint: Switch the process to its completed partner.
items.explanation: The completed carry-out is the perfective выполнил. Выполнял is the imperfective process; переделал a redo; заполнил means 'filled in (a form)'.

blanks: Вера _____ старую воду из чайника и налила свежую. (Vera poured out the old water from the kettle and poured in fresh.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: 'Pouring out from a container' signals shade 2 of вы-: вы- + лить → вылила (poured out, emptied the kettle). Лила is the impf process; налила is 'poured into a container' (which is what she did with the fresh water in the second clause); пролила means 'spilt' (unintentional).

errorCorrection.sentence: Перед экзаменом Лена поучила все слова наизусть.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Before the exam Lena learned all the words by heart.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Все слова наизусть' (all the words by heart) signals complete mastery, the вы- shade of thorough completion: выучила. Поучила means 'studied for a bit', which contradicts the full-command claim. Доучила would mean finished the last portion.

errorCorrection.sentence: Перед концертом Лена поучила все стихи наизусть.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Before the concert, Lena learned all the poems by heart.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Все стихи наизусть' (all the poems by heart) signals mastering the whole set, the вы- shade 3: выучила (note the stress on вы-). Поучила means 'studied for a while' (a bit, not to mastery), which 'все ...Наизусть' contradicts. Доучила means 'finished studying what was left', переучила 'relearned / retrained'. The all-the-X cue selects вы-.

errorCorrection.sentence: Игорь быстро понёс мусор из кухни и сразу вернулся.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Igor quickly took the rubbish out of the kitchen and came right back.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'Из кухни ...И сразу вернулся' (out of the kitchen, and came right back) signals taking the rubbish out and returning, the вы- shade 1 (out of a bounded space): вынес. Понёс is only the onset of carrying (started to carry), which 'и сразу вернулся' contradicts. Унёс means 'carried away' (to elsewhere, not back), принёс 'brought here'. The из + gen 'out of the kitchen' selects вы-.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: I (m) drank all the milk from the cup. (consume up)
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Всё молоко' (all the milk) signals shade 2 of вы-: consume up to nothing → выпил. Пил is the impf process, which the all-the-milk framing rules out.

minimalPairs.context: Антон _____ все правила к завтрашнему уроку.
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton learned all the rules through to tomorrow's lesson. (mastered completely)
minimalPairs.explanation: 'Все правила' plus 'к завтрашнему уроку' (a deadline) signals shade 3 of вы-: learn through to mastery → выучил. Учил is the impf ongoing study; the mastered-everything framing requires the вы- pf.

reviewVocab.definition: the prefix вы- (turns the verb perfective and adds an 'outward / completely done' shade; three shades: spatial out, exhaust / consume up, complete a task)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Я выпил весь чай' приставка вы- работает в значении «исчерпать», в паре с местоимением «весь».

reviewVocab.definition: all the way / to the bottom (an adverbial paraphrase that often accompanies the вы- shade; emphasises full completion or empty container)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Антон выпил чашку до дна' уточнение «до дна» подчёркивает оттенок исчерпания, который несёт вы-.

reviewVocab.definition: stress shift (the вы- prefix often pulls stress onto itself in the past tense: выпил, выучил, вышел; the bare roots have stress on the root)
reviewVocab.example: Сравните «пил» (ударение на корне) и «вы́пил» (ударение на приставке): приставка вы- перетягивает ударение.
